recommendation: Keep this source fix. It completes the applied FHIR-24861 model change while preserving the later FHIR-50532 Example binding; handle FHIR-55269 separately if its THO migration is applied.
issue_request: FHIR-24861 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for Observation. It requested support for coded qualitative reference values under Observation.referenceRange, with the final resolution to add ReferenceRange.normalValue to Observation as a CodeableConcept.
initial_application: Current source already contained Observation.referenceRange.normalValue as a CodeableConcept from commit 26dd9e3c28, later binding and terminology work, and the FHIR-50532 binding relaxation to Example. However, the parent obs-3 invariant still required low, high, or text and therefore rejected the normalValue-only use case that motivated the issue.
additional_context: The linked Zulip thread shows the concrete use case was representing values such as NEG as codes rather than text. OO minutes from 2022-02-15 record the accepted motion to add ReferenceRange.normalValue as CodeableConcept. FHIR-55269 is a later Resolved - change required THO-migration proposal for the normal-value CodeSystem, but it is not yet Applied/Published and does not alter this invariant fix.
reconciliation: Updated source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml so obs-3 accepts normalValue.exists() and marked normalValue as satisfying obs-3. Added source/observation/invariant-tests/obs-3.p4.pass.xml to cover a coded normalValue reference range with no low, high, or text.
source_changes: source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml: obs-3 now allows normalValue and the normalValue element carries condition obs-3.
source/observation/invariant-tests/obs-3.p4.pass.xml: added a passing invariant example for a coded normalValue-only reference range.

related_jiras.note: Same element; later Applied issue relaxed Observation.referenceRange.normalValue binding to Example, which this fix preserves.
Later Resolved - change required proposal to move the normal-value CodeSystem to THO; not final Applied/Published source-edit scope for this seed.
